description: This file is a Go source code file that defines functions and data structures for generating transactional store code, including parsing interface methods, extracting metadata, and generating code templates for store methods in a Mattermost-related project.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks if the given type name contains 'error'.

methods.name: isString
methods.description: Checks if the given type name is 'string'.

methods.name: isInt
methods.description: Checks if the given type name is 'int', 'int32', or 'int64'.

methods.name: isBool
methods.description: Checks if the given type name is 'bool'.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that initiates the build of the transactional store.

methods.name: buildTransactionalStore
methods.description: Generates and writes the transactional store code to a file.

methods.name: extractMethodMetadata
methods.description: Extracts method parameters, results, and transaction annotation from an AST method node.

methods.name: extractStoreMetadata
methods.description: Parses the store.go file to extract store interface methods and their metadata.

methods.name: generateLayer
methods.description: Generates code for a store layer based on templates and extracted metadata.
